1: Aey Rasool ﷺ, woh parhiye jo Allah aap par utarta hai, apne Rubb ke naam se shuru karte hue, jis ne makhlooq ko paida kiya.
2: Us ne insan ko jame hue khoon se paida kiya, us ke baad ke woh mani ki ek boond thi.
3: Aey Rasool ﷺ, woh parhiye jo Allah aap par utarta hai. Aap ka Rubb sab se zyada karam karne wala hai; koi karam karne wala us ke karam tak nahin pahunch sakta, kyunke us ka karam aur us ki bhalai bay-shumaar hai.
4: Wohi hai jis ne qalam ke zariye likhna aur wahi sikhai.
5: Us ne insan ko woh sikhaya jo woh nahin jaanta tha.
6: Beshak hadd se barhne wala insan, yani Abu Jahl, Allah ki hadon se barh kar hadd se guzar gaya,
7: sirf is liye ke us ne apne aap ko us jaah aur maal ki wajah se be-niyaz dekha jo us ke paas hai.
8: Aey insan, beshak qayamat ke din aap ke Rubb hi ki taraf lautna hai, jahan woh har shaks ko us ka haqdar badla dega.
9: Kya aap ne Abu Jahl ke maamle se zyada hayrat-naak koi baat dekhi, jis ne roka,
10: us ne mere bande Muhammad ﷺ ko roka jab woh Kaabah ke paas namaz parh rahe thay?
11: Aap kya samajhte hain, agar yeh shaks, jisey roka ja raha hai, apne Rubb ki taraf se hidayat aur basirat par hai?
12: Ya woh logon ko hukm deta hai ke Allah ke hukmon ko poora kar ke aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar us se darein; to kya aise shaks ko roka ja sakta hai?
13: Aap kya samajhte hain, agar yeh rokne wala us cheez ko jhutlaye jo Rasool laaye aur us se munh pher le? Kya woh Allah se nahin darta?
14: Kya is bande ko namaz se rokne wala nahin jaanta ke Allah us ka har kaam dekhta hai, aur us se kuch chhupa nahin?
15: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa yeh nadan samajhta hai; agar woh mere bande ko sataana aur jhutlana na chhore, to main usey zaroor pakar loonga aur us ke sar ke agle hisse se pakar kar jahannum ki taraf sakhti se ghaseet loonga.
16: Us peshani ka maalik baat mein jhoota hai aur amal mein galat.
17: Pas jab usey us ki peshani se pakar kar jahannum ki taraf le jaya jayega, to woh apne saathiyon aur hami logon ko pukare ke woh usey azaab se bachane mein madad karein.
18: Main jahannum ke daroghon ko pukarunga: woh sakht farishte jo mere hukm ki nafarmani nahin karte jab main unhein hukm doon, aur jo kuch unhein hukm diya jaye woh kar dete hain. Phir dekha jayega ke dono giroh mein se kaun zyada taaqat-war aur zyada qadir hai.
19: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa yeh zalim samajhta hai, ke woh aap ko koi nuqsan pahuncha sakta hai. Pas aap us ke hukm aur mana karne mein us ki pairwi na kijiye; balke Allah ko sajda kijiye aur farmanbardari ke aamaal ke zariye us ke qareeb hoiye, kyunke isi tarah aap us ke qareeb ho sakte hain.
